lines: I should return to the remedies and <pulse>quiet prayers</pulse>.
Best I get back to the healing shelf before someone waits too long.
That tincture still needs another careful stir.
I have a patient's notes to look over before nightfall.
The chapel bells are nearly at the hour. I should not keep them waiting.
<pulse>Back</pulse> to grinding herbs and offering calm words.
I need to see who still needs bread and bandages.
There is a prayer unfinished, and a poultice beside it.
I'll be back where the candles burn steady.
Time to finish my rounds and mend what I can.
I should check the bandages before someone needs them.
There is broth warming for anyone who missed supper.
I promised to sit with someone who should not be alone tonight.
The herb shelf needs sorting before my next round.
I have one more poultice to wrap.
The candles are low. I should tend them.
Someone is waiting for a remedy, and I have kept them long enough.
I need to wash these bottles before morning.
The chapel can use a little quiet, and so can I.
Back to my rounds. Come find me if you need help.
